tei:div.tei:p: bskang ba ni/ hrī: dbang chen lha tshogs 'od dpag med pa dang*// gsang ba ye shes rje btsun gu ru rje// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas// thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// mchog chen mchog phran mtshan dang ldan pas bskangs// sa le 'bri dang shel sgong lug gis bskang*// tsa ra mkha' lding mdangs kyis bskang*// bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas bskang*// rakta dmar gyi arghas bskang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtor mas bskang*// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang*// sha chen lang ling sna tshogs dang*| /snang gsal zhun gyi mar mes bskang*// tshil chen gsur gyi dud pas bskang*// thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgras bskang*// rkang chen dung gi gling bus bskang*// thun mong mchod pa sna tshogs kyis// lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod// bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang*// sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor| /bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral// ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang*// yig brgya bzlas/ sku'i rgyud rta dbu lnga pa las gsungs pa'i bskang ba 'di hya ghṛ wa la sbyar ba nges par 'thad snyam nas cung zad tshig kha bsgyur ba phrin las rdo rjes bkod pa'o/// /
